name: Window Manager for XENEON
description:
Window Manager for XENEON turns CORSAIR XENEON Edge into a dedicated touch strip for your Windows desktop.

See currently open top-level application windows with the app name, useful window title, current state and monitor. Tap any card to bring that window forward, then use large touch controls to minimize, maximize or restore, snap left, snap right, move it to any detected monitor, or close it with an explicit confirmation step.

Pin favorite applications so the apps you care about stay at the edge of the strip even when they are closed. The active foreground window is highlighted clearly, while empty, disconnected, pairing and no-active-window states stay explicit instead of showing stale data.

The interface is designed separately for all eight XENEON Edge size and orientation combinations. Wide layouts behave like a visual desktop control strip rather than stretched Stream Deck keys, while vertical layouts become a compact scrollable window list with the same controls.

Windows does not expose arbitrary desktop-window enumeration and placement to a normal iCUE web widget, so this product uses the free PackRat Window Bridge companion on Windows. The bridge owns the native Win32 calls, listens only on 127.0.0.1, requires a local pairing key, caches app icons locally and pushes changes to the widget. Window titles, process metadata and commands are not sent to a cloud service.

The bridge uses Windows window-change notifications for fast updates plus a slow reconciliation pass so the panel stays current without continuously enumerating the desktop.

Part of the PackRat Ecosystem.
release_notes:
• Shows live open Windows apps with titles, app icons, active state and monitor.
• Adds touch focus, minimize, maximize/restore, snap left/right and multi-monitor movement.
• Adds safe close confirmation and locally stored favorite application pins.
• Uses a paired localhost PackRat Window Bridge with event-driven updates and a low-frequency reconciliation scan.
• Includes tuned horizontal and vertical layouts for all eight XENEON Edge slot presets.
